import pandas as pd
# Load downtime data
dt = pd.read_excel('data/downtime.xlsx', sheet_name='정지이력')
# Convert minutes to hours
dt['정지시간_h'] = dt['정지시간(분)'] / 60.0
# Calculate week number based on start date 2026-03-02
start_date = pd.Timestamp('2026-03-02')
dt['일자_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(dt['일자'])
dt['주차'] = ((dt['일자_dt'] - start_date).dt.days // 7) + 1
# Aggregate total downtime hours per week
dt_weekly = dt.groupby('주차')['정지시간_h'].sum().reset_index()
dt_weekly.rename(columns={'정지시간_h': '정지시간_h'}, inplace=True)
# Load run log weekly summary
rl = pd.read_excel('data/run_log.xlsx', sheet_name='주간요약')
# Merge the two datasets by week
merged = pd.merge(rl, dt_weekly, on='주차', how='inner')
df = merged
